comment: Independent C-first recording for options.c:optfn_glyph()'s do_set arm while no symset is named. glyphs.c to_custom_symset_entry_callback() cannot store the S_ant Unicode and color details and reports 'Unimplemented customization feature, ignoring for now' once for each kind through config_error_add(), which cfgfiles.c config_erradd() prints with pline() and wait_synch() outside a configuration read; Return dismisses the --More-- the first wait_synch() raises. A second glyph value with both kinds shows the static glyphnag and colornag counters suppress the repeat; two steps east then play on.
